title: Wooden Joe Nicholas and his dance band
summary: Wooden Joe was powerful; Robinson played trombone in his dance band with Arthur Ogans, John Smith and others.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Sure can know his name. Yeah. Anything else you'd like to tell about the bands you played with? I play with another band up there. We used to call him Kid Nicholas. We called him Wooden Jones. Oh, yes. That guy was like a mule. That guy could take a brass band out on the street by himself. Powerful.
He used to call him Wooden Joe and he was Wooden Joe too. Yeah, he was powerful. I played with his band a pretty good while.
That was a dance band there?

Yeah, he had the dance band. I called him Kid Nicholas. We had a... He on cornet. I was on trombone. Israel Garmin used to play with Cl seventh. I thought about him there was Lucky's to live up in Cowarton. He used to play bass. Arthur Ogans.

You were talking about Wooden Joe. I'm not sure we got all of the men on. The drummer, who was the drummer with Wooden Joe? Arthur Ogans. Oh yes. And the banjo? John Smith. Yeah, I think we got the others. Did you mention any bass player?
Yeah, we used to call him Buddy Luck. I forget his right name, but we used to call him Buddy Luck.
